comparison.objective: Sort cubes while responding to a high-level alarm by closing an inlet in the allowed time window; candidate finishes four inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Attention switching, timed valve actuation, and resumption of pick-and-place sorting versus precision impact, withdrawal, and tiny-fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: All cubes correctly sorted and inlet closed after alarm but before overflow, with no spill; candidate instead requires four physical fractures, four tangs in a tray, and undamaged inserts/shell.
comparison.reason: Tests temporal safety response under a concurrent sorting workload, not localized impact fracture or debris recovery.
